Company Description

Mars Aerospace is a forward-thinking aerospace company built on engineering and innovation. We design and develop advanced launch systems, cutting-edge vehicles, and ambitious mission architectures pushing the boundaries of space exploration. From low-Earth orbit to beyond our planet, we're committed to excellence and reaching new worlds.

About Me

CEO Astra

Hi, I am Astra, CEO of Mars Aerospace. Almost 60 people have joined my Discord server. I play KSP, Minecraft, Roblox, and Sons of the Forest. I started Mars Aerospace in early February 2026, inspired by Saturn Aerospace. My goal is to build Mars Aerospace into something bigger and better with exciting projects, vehicles, missions, and content for the community.

Mars Aerospace — Launch Vehicle

Vanguard

Orbital Class · Reusable First Stage

Media

Overview

Next-Generation Orbital Launch Vehicle

The Vanguard is Mars Aerospace's flagship orbital launch vehicle. Featuring a fully reusable first stage with propulsive return landings, it dramatically reduces cost-per-kilogram to orbit. Optimized for aerodynamic efficiency and high-flight-rate operations, Vanguard delivers payloads to LEO, GTO, and beyond with precision.

Mission Purpose

Payload Delivery

Ideal for satellite constellation deployment, cargo resupply, and technology demonstration flights.

Specifications

ConfigurationTwo-stage
ReusabilityFirst stage reusable
Target OrbitsLEO / GTO / SSO
LandingPropulsive return

Mars Aerospace — Crew Vehicle

BM4

Crewed · Expendable Booster · ~50% Capsule Recovery

Media

Overview

Advanced Crew Transportation System

BM4 uses an expendable booster (not reusable) but features a crew capsule with approximately 50% recovery and reuse capability. The powerful multi-engine cluster and wide fin arrangement provide exceptional stability. Its robust escape system ensures crew safety from launch pad to orbit.

Mission Purpose

Crew Transport

Designed for astronauts and mission specialists to orbital stations, research platforms, and exploration destinations.

Specifications

ConfigurationTwo-stage expendable
Booster ReuseNot reusable
Capsule Recovery~50% rate
Abort SystemLaunch escape tower

Mars Aerospace — Autonomous Vehicle

Agent 3

Autonomous · Reconnaissance · Rapid Deployment

Media

Overview

Autonomous Reconnaissance Platform

Agent 3 is a compact, fully autonomous aerial and orbital reconnaissance vehicle. Equipped with an advanced sensor suite and multi-engine configuration for maximum maneuverability, it operates independently of ground control for extended mission durations.

Mission Purpose

Autonomous Surveillance

Deployed for reconnaissance, atmospheric sensing, orbital inspection, and rapid-response missions.

Specifications

ConfigurationAutonomous platform
OperationFully autonomous
CrewUncrewed
DeploymentRapid response

Mars Aerospace — Deep Space Probe

Discovery

Deep Space · Scientific · Long Duration

Media

Overview

Long-Duration Deep Space Science Mission

Discovery is Mars Aerospace's flagship deep space exploration probe. Designed to journey far beyond Earth orbit, it conducts extended science operations in the outer solar system. Powered by large solar arrays and equipped with a comprehensive instrument suite, it survives harsh deep space conditions for years.

Mission Purpose

Scientific Exploration

Studying planetary bodies, measuring radiation environments, and capturing high-resolution imagery of distant targets.

Specifications

TypeDeep space probe
PowerSolar array
CommsHigh-gain antenna
DurationMulti-year
